remarks:
Welcome to 2835 Greenhurst Ave, a truly special Greenhurst home filled with character, history, and lake lifestyle perks. Enjoy access to short-term rental opportunities along with dock access right at the end of the street through the Greenhurst Lake Association. Originally built in 1908 as a “Tea House” in support of the Chautauqua Lake Railway, which once ran from Jamestown to Mayville, this property offers a unique connection to the area’s past. The nearby train station was located where the current post office stands, and the Greenhurst Hotel once sat along the lakefront where the association property is today. Converted into a residence in 1940, this home blends historic charm with thoughtful modern updates.

Offering 4 bedrooms and 2 full updated baths, with one full bath on each floor, the home features an updated kitchen, comfortable living spaces, a covered front porch, balcony, large yard, and partially fenced outdoor space. Deeded lake rights include access to a boat slip, and the dock is only 3 years old, making it easy to enjoy days on beautiful Chautauqua Lake.

Recent improvements include a 2021 kitchen remodel, furnace, and electrical service; a laundry room addition, hot water tank, and rebuilt porch in 2022; a downstairs bathroom remodel in 2020; and an upstairs bathroom remodel in 2024. A massive attic with pull-down stair access provides excellent storage or future possibilities. A rare opportunity to own a home with history, updates, lake rights, and a boat slip in the heart of Greenhurst!
